title: D1u SMP Modpack S1
description: This is the modpack for D1u S1 - Reborn. A public, fabric-1.20.1, origins server, with custom playerbuilt lore as you explore a medieval fantasy world.
body:
![background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ba0b2ea469ef8ebe71590411139f1f2aa949c7f_0.webp)
# D1u S1

 D1u S1 is a medieval fantasy modpack based on our SMP. It has roughly 80 mods and is optimised for low performace devices.

Origins🐾 - Choose from a wide array of unique playstyles with our original selection new origins, if one doesn't suit you, purchase a custom from our store!

Revamped Terrain🌲- Explore a custom world with mods like [Oh the biomes we've gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/oh-the-biomes-weve-gone), [Pale Garden Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/pale-garden-backport), and [Regions Unexplored](https://modrinth.com/mod/regions-unexplored)

Lore📜 - Join our server's rich lore and interact with others in the community

Building🛠️ - Construct grand castles with [Templates 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/templates-2) and [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped) to build the base of your dreams

Custom Player models👗 - Tired of steve? Express yourself your way with a [Figura](https://modrinth.com/mod/figura) avatar of your choice

Enhanced progression⚔️ - Netherite gear feeling repetitive? expand your arsenal with [Medieval Weapons](https://modrinth.com/mod/medievalweapons), even higher tiers with [Advanced Netherite](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-netherite), and fight the revamped Ender Dragon for the final upgrade tier.

Join our Discord and help support us with our store!
